Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the outreach and the product overview. Before we can run a live demo with our engineering team, procurement/legal require that Redwood complete our vendor intake: the attached questionnaire and a mutual NDA. Our vendor portal will also ask for SOC2 evidence and the standard security checklist.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Complete the attached questionnaire in the portal (link below)
- Sign our standard mutual NDA (I can route via DocuSign)

If those items are in progress, we can tentatively keep the demo time but procurement may ask us to postpone until paperwork is complete. Our legal lead (Lara Wexler) and procurement are cc'd.

Portal link: https://vendor-portal.hillsidehealth.com/intake/HLSD-0012
Attachment: Hillside_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (fillable)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement is stretched this week.

Best,

Hi Erin — thanks for the heads up and the questionnaire. We can absolutely complete the intake and sign the NDA; we'll prioritize this.

Immediate next steps from our side:
1) I will get the questionnaire filled in the portal today (Priyom is onboarded to help provide the technical answers).
2) Ben will coordinate on the commercial side for any procurement items.
3) If Hillside can send the DocuSign link for the NDA, we will review and return with any redlines within 24 hours.

To avoid blocking your calendar, would you prefer we move the demo to the week of Mar 15 as a tentative date? If procurement finishes sooner we're happy to keep the earlier slot as a placeholder — just let us know what works best.

Attaching a draft we can use as a starting point internally.
Attachment: Redwood_intake_prep_notes.txt (internal)

Thanks — we'll be in touch by EOD with the filled questionnaire.

— Soojin

- Priyom: can you take point on the questionnaire? Hillside wants SOC2 evidence and answers about KV cache isolation, data retention, and private deployment options. They flagged the security checklist as a blocker for the demo.

- Tue, Mar 16, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Wed, Mar 17, 13:00–14:00 PT
